about: Taff of the week, on the home page. Week 1 starts Monday 26 October 2026 with photo 1, and the list loops back to photo 1 after the last one. Read by js/taff-of-the-week.js.

weeks.caption: Dressed up for Halloween. He is not impressed.
weeks.idea: Ask the customer what they value.
weeks.ideaMore: Nobody asked Taff if he wanted a hat.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon wearing a small orange Halloween hat with bat wings

weeks.caption: Breakfast is served.
weeks.ideaMore: Fresh food arrives when it's needed, not a week early.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon in his vivarium next to a bowl of fresh greens

weeks.caption: About to pounce.
weeks.ideaMore: Watch the beard. If it goes dark, stop what you're doing.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon held on a hand in a sunny garden, looking alert

weeks.caption: Bath time.
weeks.ideaMore: Same steps, same order, every time, so nothing gets missed.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon having a shallow bath in a white tub

weeks.caption: A long stretch on the garden bench.
weeks.ideaMore: No stops, no waiting, just one smooth line from start to finish.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon stretched out on a wooden garden bench in the sun

weeks.caption: Guarding the water bowl.
weeks.ideaMore: It's the one thing everything else waits for.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon sitting in his water bowl next to his food

weeks.caption: Warming up on his heat slab.
weeks.ideaMore: This is his spot, and everyone knows it.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon lying on a dark slab on white decking

weeks.caption: On the table again.
weeks.ideaMore: Why is he on the table? Because it's warm. Why is it warm? Keep going.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon curled on a white garden table by a brick wall

weeks.caption: Checking the view from the summer house.
weeks.ideaMore: You learn more by looking than by guessing.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon climbing a wooden branch on green matting

weeks.caption: On patrol across the living room.
weeks.ideaMore: He walked the long way round. Twice.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon walking across a wooden living room floor

weeks.caption: Climbing up to check the lamp.
weeks.ideaMore: Big changes are made of lots of little climbs.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon climbing a bamboo log in his vivarium

weeks.caption: Posing for the camera.
weeks.ideaMore: If it went well, show people.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon posing on a white garden table in bright sun

weeks.caption: Sunbathing on a branch.
weeks.ideaMore: Find a warm spot, then find a slightly warmer one.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon on a driftwood branch against a brick wall

weeks.caption: Sitting comfortably.
weeks.ideaMore: Hold him like this and nobody gets dropped.
weeks.alt: Bearded dragon sitting on an open hand in the garden
